posts.title: The Filament Hook You Needed Was Already There: mutateFormDataBeforeCreate and Friends
posts.description: Overriding save() on a Filament page is how you break on the next minor release. The hooks that do the same job are already there — here is the order they actually run in.

posts.title: Filament Without the Panel: Using v5 Schemas, Tables and Actions in Your Own Livewire Pages
posts.description: You built the admin in Filament and it is excellent. Now customers need their own page, on your layout, outside /admin. You do not have to rebuild the forms by hand, and you do not have to bend a panel into a front end.

posts.title: Ask One Cheap Question First: Screening Work With a Jev Noul in Laravel
posts.description: Your pipeline pays full price for the newsletters. One Noul in front of the expensive step, two thresholds and a chained job, and it stops.
